name: Akiho Rindou
main_effect:
[On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 red Digimon card with the [Vaccine] trait among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
[Your Turn] When you play a red Digimon with [Avian], [Bird], [Beast], [Animal] or [Sovereign] in any of its traits (other than [Sea Animal] trait), by an effect, by suspending this Tamer, that Digimon gains ＜Rush＞ for the turn. (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.)
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
